cards.summary: Card grids (services, features, content cards): list = one item per row, media or icon left, text right.

ctaBanner.summary: Call-to-action banners: centered = heading, text and button stacked and centred.

faq.summary: FAQ: split = heading in a left column, questions on the right (desktop).

team.summary: Team: list = one member per row, photo left, credentials and bio right.

testimonials.summary: Testimonials (grid): featured = the first quote as a large pull quote, the rest below.
